summary: Onboard a new Grafana Cloud account: invite teammates, install a data source and integration, set billing/usage alerts, find learning paths.

needs.description: Grafana Cloud org Admin (portal admin) to invite users and configure settings.
Cost Management and Billing app (grafana-cmab-app) available with permission to create usage alerts (Usage Alerts RBAC role).
needs.evidence: setup-billing-alerts: on-page:/a/grafana-cmab-app/usage-alerts; permissions granted by the Usage ... role

needs.description: Cloud Portal access (grafana.com) to invite a user by email; creates a pending invite for a real email address.
needs.evidence: invite-team-members: open Cloud Portal and invite a user

reviewNotes: Invite step has side effects (emails) and may need a throwaway address; billing alerts may need a paid/specific plan. Only some steps need Admin.
